lines.en: I hop along. Very small.
I'm round, like a ball.
Step by step. Short legs.
I waddle and wobble my head.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，走两步喘一下。
lines.en: I follow, and every two steps I pant.
I roll once and get back up.
The grass here is taller than me.
I step on leaves and they rustle.
I can't go around. I squeeze through.
I walk behind you so I don't get lost.
My two short legs churn fast.
I bounce along to catch up.
I sit and hug my own foot.
I sit, waiting for you to pat my head.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，眼睛眯起来。
lines.en: I yawn and my eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 我身上有点圆，也有点软。
lines.en: I'm round, and a little soft.
I'm watching ants carry things.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像个小团子。
lines.en: I hold still, a little lump.
I count the growls of my stomach.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩起来，省点力气。
lines.en: I curl up to save energy.
Safe here. I'm not afraid.
I doze off beside your boots.
I roll over and lie flat.
I sniff the grass I just stepped on.
I lick my own forepaw.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到有太阳的地方。
lines.en: I shuffle into a sunny spot.
Sit down and I can see you.
I look up. You're very tall.

lines.zh: 我抬头，只看到你的膝盖。
lines.en: I look up and see only your knees.
Picking me up?
I'm not afraid. You're warm.

lines.zh: 我从你的膝盖后面探出头。
lines.en: I peek out from behind your knee.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，等你说什么。
lines.en: I look up, waiting for you to speak.
I'm young, and my teeth are fine.
Lower your hand and I'll come over.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你看得见我吗？
lines.en: So small — can you see me?
I lean against your foot.

lines.zh: 你的手指伸过来，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Your finger comes closer; I sniff it.
I stand on two short legs.
I look up at you until my neck aches.

lines.zh: 你要是蹲着，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: If you crouch, I'll dare come close.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，够不到你。
lines.en: I raise my hands. Can't reach you.
I hold my head and roll to your feet.
I've hidden behind you.

lines.zh: 疼得我尾巴都卷起来了。
lines.en: It hurts so much my tail curls up.
A Yarmon, and my fangs are small.
That hit my back.
A small body can still stand up.
I get up slowly. My legs are weak.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵贴着头，抖个不停。
lines.en: My ears are flat and I keep trembling.
I haven't grown proper horns yet.

lines.zh: 我缩起四肢，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I tuck in my limbs and play at being a stone.
Food! I smell food!
I bounce over. Fast.

lines.zh: 这个闻着像幼年期的饲料。
lines.en: This smells like rookie feed.

lines.zh: 我一口就吃掉了，还有吗？
lines.en: One bite and it is gone — is there more?
I licked the bowl clean.

lines.zh: 饲料渣沾在我的鼻尖上。
lines.en: Feed crumbs stick to the tip of my nose.
I hop three times and still fall short.
I sit and wait for you to lower it.
Crumbs are still in my mouth.
I've logged this smell.
Is this for me?

lines.zh: 我两只小角，只顶得到你的脚踝。
lines.en: My little horns barely reach your ankle.
I bump and roll half a turn.
I brush myself off and get up.
I bumped you and tipped over first.
I'm round. One touch and I roll.
I roll to your feet and stop.
That made my head spin.

lines.zh: 我拍拍肚皮上的土，站稳。
lines.en: I brush the dirt off my belly and stand.

lines.zh: 别踩到我，我就在你脚边。
lines.en: Do not step on me, I am right at your feet.

lines.zh: 一格的小兽，草里就没了。
lines.en: One block tall—in the grass I vanish.

lines.zh: 我甩甩脑袋，耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: I shake my head; my ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 我歪头，听不懂你在说什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head, not understanding.
I sit leaning on you.
You sit; I lie beside you.
I lean against you and fall asleep.
I make no sound. I just watch you.

lines.zh: 你的手掌比我的脑袋大。
lines.en: Your palm is bigger than my head.
I slept deeply tonight.

lines.zh: 梦里我变成了别的东西。
lines.en: In my dream I became something else.
It is morning, and you are still beside me.
Even grown, I won't leave.
I lift it. Hard work.
I tuck it away beside my cheek.
Two bounces and I call it a walk.
I hug it with two short arms.
I cannot lift it, so I push it along.
I can't drag it. Only roll it.
I hide it in the grass.
I carry it two steps.
I can carry this little stone.
I hold it and sit still.
Something's coming. I hide.
I shut my eyes and wait for it to pass.
I shift behind you.
One move from me and the grass sways.
I'm small. I can't win.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，藏在草里。
lines.en: I flatten out in the grass.
I'm waiting for you to come back.
Something's footsteps. Heavy ones.
I stay quiet so I'm not heard.
If it comes close, I'll roll away.
I'm shaking, but I haven't left.

lines.zh: 幼年期的小角，喊我就回来。
lines.en: A baby-stage horn. Call and I come back.
I watch it, afraid to move.
It goes left; I dodge left.
I press against your leg.

lines.zh: 我这么小，退得比进得快。
lines.en: Small as I am, I retreat faster than I advance.
I bury my mouth in my belly.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，装成石头。
lines.en: I lower my head and pass for a stone.
So small, one gust sways me.
It has not noticed me. Wait a little more.
I hold my breath and press into the grass.
Reach out and I'll scramble to you.
I shuffle along by your boots.
If it moves, I run.

lines.zh: 也也兽的泡泡，飘过来了。
lines.en: Yarmon's bubble drifts over.

lines.zh: 我用整个身体顶它一下。
lines.en: I push at it with my whole body.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己都晃了，泡泡破了。
lines.en: That one shook even me; a bubble popped.

lines.zh: 我的泡泡先撞在它脸上。
lines.en: My bubble hits its face first.
I hit and run.
Missed the pounce and fell over.

lines.zh: 泡泡破了，什么也没留下。
lines.en: The bubble pops. Nothing left.
I lunge and get knocked back.
I'm panting. Can't run.
I roll into the grass and crawl back out.
I retreat behind you.

lines.zh: 我圆圆的像个球，这一下尽力了。
lines.en: Round as a ball, I gave that blow everything.
I roll over and stand up.
So big here. I'm a bit scared.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，晃晃头。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil and shake my head.
I'm small. The grass is taller.
I poke my head out of the leaf pile.
I wait for you to find me.
Smells like food here.
I shuffle two steps.
I raise my head to the sun.
I don't have a name yet.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音很细很细。
lines.en: I call out, thin and small.
I have crawled out of the eggshell.
Fire scorches me and I roll aside.
I fall and yelp.
I swallow water and cannot float up.

lines.zh: 炸响把我吹出去，滚了几圈。
lines.en: The blast throws me; I roll.

lines.zh: 东西扎在我身上，我拔不出来。
lines.en: It's stuck in me. I can't pull it out.

lines.zh: 幼年期Ⅱ的我，被法术绑住。
lines.en: A Baby II bound by a spell.
Too hungry. My belly's flat.
Lightning strikes and I curl right up.
I drop into the void, legs kicking.
